statement: let R := fun (q n : ℕ) => ∑ d ∈ q.divisors.filter (fun d => d ∣ n), (d:ℝ)*(ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q/d):ℝ); ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : ℕ → ℝ), 30 ∣ n → (∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc (1:ℕ) 105, 0≤K q ∧ K q≤1) → (∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc (1:ℕ) 105, q ∣ 30 → 1-2*(q:ℝ)/(9*105)≤K q) → (351/100:ℝ) < ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc (1:ℕ) 105, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius q:ℝ)^2/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2*R q n*K q

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9009 · 给 30 的倍数计算带符号主弧模型的有限下界表
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9009 · Bound the signed major-arc model table on multiples of 30

brief.zh: q∣30 的贡献至少 26/7。其余负项由 q 的一个不整除 n 的素因子控制，各项上界的有理数和小于 201/1000。复用 Ramanujan 和的 CRT 分解。
brief.en: Denominators dividing 30 contribute at least 26/7. Bound each possible negative term with a prime factor of q that does not divide n. The rational sum of these bounds is below 201/1000. Use the CRT factorization of Ramanujan sums.
